title: Germ compatibility of the target section class with a fixed resolution
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ and $g:S\prime\to S$ be scheme morphisms, $F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module, $I$ an injective resolution of $F$, $K$ an injective resolution of $G=(\operatorname{pr}_X)^*F$, $V\subseteq S$ open, $y\in V$, and $D$ choices of [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices]. Set $h=\operatorname{pr}_{S\prime}$ and $W=\operatorname{pr}_X^{-1}(f^{-1}V)$. For every $p\in\mathbf N$ and $\eta\in H^p(S\prime\times_S X,G)$, the top germ at $y$ in $g_*R^ph_*G$ of the top section class computed with $K$ equals the germ over $V$ of $D.\mathrm{targetClass}_p$ applied to the restriction of $\eta$ to $W$. The top section class is resolutionSectionClass of [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices] using $K,h_*K$, the top open and the degreewise identity, followed by the inverse right-derived resolution comparison. The restriction is the restriction-unit cohomology map of [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap], and targetClass is [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-resolution-construction]. This formula holds with K fixed; it has no comparison with a separately chosen global resolution or with the defined localDirectImage_stalk_class map.

proof.text: Apply restrictedResolution_cohomology to K and D.target. It computes restriction on raw section-complex cohomology with the fixed resolution. Transport the inverse-image open using flatBaseChangeOpenEquality.

For the pushforward complex L, apply Mathlib NatTrans.app_homology to the evaluation restriction transformation. Short-complex extensionality identifies the resulting homology map with restriction of the section complex. Naturality of sectionCohomologyTheta then proves the section-class restriction square. Compose the raw comparison with this square.

Naturality of the presheaf map underlying isoRightDerivedObj.inv commutes its section maps with restriction. Evaluate the resulting morphism equality at eta. Applying the germ over V and Mathlib TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply yields the unchanged displayed germ equality.

proof_origin.place: Y3: restriction is computed by the new general raw-cohomology theorem; evaluation homology naturality, theta naturality, derived-comparison presheaf naturality, and germ_res_apply complete the original statement.

theorem FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices.targetClass_restriction {X S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {F : X.Modules} {I : InjectiveResolution F}
    {K : InjectiveResolution ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F)}
    {V : S.Opens} (D : FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f g F I K V) (p : ℕ)
    (y : S) (hy : y ∈ V)
    (eta : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (Limits.pullback g f).toRingedSpace p).obj
      ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F)) :
    TopCat.Presheaf.germ
      ((pushforward g).obj
        (((pushforward (pullback.fst g f)).rightDerived p).obj
          ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F))).presheaf ⊤ y (by trivial)
      (Hom.app (K.isoRightDerivedObj (pushforward (pullback.fst g f)) p).inv ⊤
        (resolutionSectionClass K
          (((pushforward (pullback.fst g f)).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj K.cocomplex) ⊤ (Iso.refl _) p eta)) =
    TopCat.Presheaf.germ
      ((pushforward g).obj
        (((pushforward (pullback.fst g f)).rightDerived p).obj
          ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F))).presheaf V y hy
      (D.targetClass p
        (moduleCohomologyFMap ((pullback.snd g f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).ι
          ((restrictAdjunction ((pullback.snd g f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).ι).unit.app
            ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F)) p eta))
